message.content:
I’m not entirely sure what you’re aiming to start—do you want to bring up the Docker Desktop application (i.e., the Docker Engine service) on Windows, or are you trying to start a specific container named “docker” using `docker start`?  

If you’re looking to start the Docker Engine itself, you can do it from an elevated PowerShell prompt with one of the following commands:

```powershell
# Option 1 – Start the Docker Desktop service
Start-Service -Name com.docker.service

# Option 2 – Equivalent net command
net start com.docker.service
```

If you’re trying to start a container, you’d first need to know its container ID or name, then run something like:

```bash
docker start <container-id-or-name>
```

Let me know which scenario applies (or if you need help finding the container name), and I can give you a more precise command or script.
